assertions.notes: The modal cannot be visually tested in browser context because it only renders when allProxiesFailedState is non-null, which requires actual proxy failure events from the Tauri backend. However, comprehensive unit tests (18 passing) and source code verification confirm the component correctly renders all three options. The modal is properly wired in ValidationDashboard with conditional rendering based on allProxiesFailedState.

assertions.title: No proxies configured warning - User attempts validation with proxy enabled but no proxies configured. Warning shown.

steps.expected: Proxy settings UI visible with 'No proxies configured' placeholder
steps.observed: Proxy settings tab shows 'No proxies configured' and 'Add proxies to enable proxy-based validation' text in the proxy list area when no proxies are added

steps.action: Take screenshot of proxy settings with empty state
steps.expected: Screenshot shows the 'No proxies configured' message
steps.observed: Screenshot saved showing the empty proxy list with placeholder text

steps.action: Check if handleStartValidation validates proxy state before starting
steps.expected: Warning or prevention when proxy enabled but no proxies configured
steps.observed: handleStartValidation in App.tsx only checks 'if (emails.length === 0 || isProcessing) return' - NO check for proxy enabled + empty proxy list

steps.action: Check if use-email-validation hook validates proxy state
steps.expected: startValidation should warn about missing proxies
steps.observed: startValidation in use-email-validation.ts has no proxy configuration validation - it directly calls mutation.mutate()

steps.action: Search codebase for any proxy-enabled-but-empty warning
steps.expected: Warning dialog or toast when proxy enabled but empty
steps.observed: No such warning exists anywhere in the codebase. The only 'No proxies configured' text is a static placeholder in proxy-list.tsx (settings UI)

evidence.consoleErrors: Only Tauri IPC errors (transformCallback) - expected in browser context
evidence.codeAnalysis: handleStartValidation (App.tsx:62-66) has no proxy check. startValidation (use-email-validation.ts:167-182) has no proxy check. No toast/notification for missing proxies exists.

assertions.issues: The 'No proxies configured' text only exists as a static placeholder in the proxy settings UI (proxy-list.tsx:310). There is NO warning when a user attempts to start validation with proxy enabled but no proxies configured. The handleStartValidation function in App.tsx and startValidation in use-email-validation.ts do not check for this condition.
assertions.notes: VAL-FLR-007 requires a warning when the user attempts validation with proxy enabled but no proxies configured. This warning does not exist. The 'No proxies configured' text visible in Settings > Proxy tab is a static placeholder, not a validation warning. The assertion should either be marked as not implemented, or a warning needs to be added to handleStartValidation/startValidation.
